review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Cell cilia part (S4 editor): a lens-shaped pad of twelve short hairs in three rows; shape key Beat bends them in a power stroke toward the tail.

textures.name: T_PartCilia_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_PartCilia_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

attachment.origin: attachment point on the body surface

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

shape_keys.Beat: power stroke toward the tail, rows lagging; rests at 0, the engine drives it 0 to 1 and back

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_cell_parts.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
